title: Pineapple Suprise Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Unusual Variety
description:
Bring a vibrant, tropical splash to your garden or home!




 KEY FEATURES


• Unique tricolour foliage with chartreuse, burgundy, and green


• Vigorous and robust growth habit, perfect for containers and beds


• Late flowering for extended foliage display


• Adaptable to sun (in humid conditions) and shade


• Low maintenance and disease-resistant




 PLANT DETAILS


Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides


Colour: Chartreuse, deep burgundy, and green foliage


Season: All year round (foliage)


Growth Habit: Upright




 GROWING CONDITIONS


Sun: Sun (humid regions) to Partial Shade


Soil: Light, humus-rich, well-draining soil


Watering: Medium; keep consistently moist but not waterlogged. Water regularly in pots.


Spacing: 30 - 41 cm (12 - 16 inches)


Height: 46 - 66 cm (18 - 26 inches)


Spread: 46 - 56 cm (18 - 22 inches)


Hardiness: UK H1C (Frost Tender, min 10°C)




 CARE INSTRUCTIONS


• Plant after the last frost in a sheltered location.


• Morning sun is tolerated, but avoid hot, direct afternoon sun.


• Fertilise every two weeks during the growing season (June to September).


• Pinch off any emerging flower spikes to encourage bushier growth and maintain foliage vibrancy.


• Can be overwintered indoors as a houseplant before the first frost.




 WHAT'S INCLUDED


2x Mini Plug Plants
